text:
Alex K: Quick sync — finalizing the release train staging window for Wed 09:00 PT -> canary. Need deploy owners, smoke owner, and rollback readiness. Who can take api-service and model-worker?
Maria T: I can own api-service deploy. I'll be on-call 08:30-10:30 PT. Planning canary at 09:25 (need a few minutes to warm caches).
Sanjay P: I'll take model-worker. CI green, PR merged: https://github.com/redwood-inference/model-worker/commit/abcd1234. Can do canary at 09:30.
Zoe R: I'll run the smoke tests for both. Quick checklist I'll run: 
`````
- health: GET /health -> 200
- sample-gen: run ./smoke_tests/sample_gen.sh (exit 0)
- latency: p95 < 200ms for baseline loads
- errors: <1% on canary traffic
- logs: no stack traces in last 10m
- rollback dry-run succeeds
`````
Alex K: @Maria T @Sanjay P please add rollback commands to your PR descriptions and tag this thread. Also ping releases channel right before starting :thumbsup:
Maria T: added rollback snippet to PR. rollback command (staging): `kubectl rollout undo deployment/api-service -n staging --to-revision=v2026-09-12-rc`
Sanjay P: model-worker rollback documented: `kubectl set image deployment/model-worker model-worker=worker:v1.9 --record` + image tag snapshot worker:v2-rc3 for quick promote.
deploy-bot: Pipeline passed for api-service (staging) — build #542 :white_check_mark:
Dan L: I'll keep the feature-flag gate closed (ff:enable-new-routing = off) until you confirm smoke pass. I can toggle after Zoe signs off.
Linda G: I'll monitor logs/alerts and Grafana during the window (dashboard: https://grafana.redwood/dashboard/d/abcd). If error rate >5% or CPU spike >80% for 5m, we rollback immediately.
Alex K: Plan timeline (updated):
- 09:00: deploy window opens
- 09:25: api-service canary (small % traffic)
- 09:30: model-worker canary
- 09:40: smoke tests start (Zoe)
- 09:50: promote to full if green
If anyone needs to shift, call it out now.
Maria T: small request — move api canary to 09:27? need 2 extra mins to pre-warm.
Alex K: OK moved to 09:27. Updated above.
Zoe R: Copy, will post smoke run results here. If all green I will add :white_check_mark: and note the checks that failed/passed.
Sanjay P: tagging @Dan L for config flip after smoke.
Maria T: thanks — I'll start the deploy at 09:25 to be ready for 09:27 canary.
Alex K: Thanks everyone. I'll remind releases channel 5m before start and pin this thread for post-deploy notes. :rocket:
